response.overview: Clairvoyant – The Awakening explores the hidden world of psychic phenomena. It challenges taboos around clairvoyance, telepathy and remote viewing by featuring psychics, scientists and insiders. The film reveals how mainstream institutions have historically suppressed these abilities and includes accounts of near-death visions, secret experiments, and mystical experiences. Through compelling interviews and stories, it asks whether human consciousness truly extends beyond the brain and suggests we may be ignoring our own untapped potential.
response.title: Clairvoyant - The Awakening
